primary_arm_rationale: the registered arm set names mlb.winner.CHAMPION_V13 and the owner's own EV cross-check reproduces to within 0.01pp against it on all seven candidates, which is decisive. It remains LEGACY_TRIAL_COUNT and may not be described as meeting the 100k standard.

hundred_k_contract.evidence: the 30k/100k differences are consistent with pure simulation noise: max 0.7127pp against an expected difference sd of 0.3276pp, i.e. 2.18 sigma on the largest of ten games. Two draw counts of one model are not two models.
hundred_k_contract.why_not_a_second_arm: it cannot simultaneously be the same champion and a second comparison arm, and counting it twice would inflate the Holm burden for no information.

uncertainty_pipeline.what_was_attempted: a date-blocked out-of-sample calibration-level SD from pre-2026-08-24 graded V13 forecasts
uncertainty_pipeline.why_it_failed: 168 graded forecasts exist across 7 dates, but 5 of those dates now carry PROVISIONAL results and provisional evidence may not feed an authoritative output — the same rule adaptive_state.asof enforces on the priors. That leaves k=2 admissible date blocks (2026-08-20, 2026-08-21) and 38 rows. Two numbers are not a standard deviation.
uncertainty_pipeline.and_one_of_the_two_is_contaminated: 2026-08-21 records home 14-1. Under the expanding prior p=0.520540 that is P=0.00083, about 1 in 1209. One of only two admissible blocks being a 1-in-1209 slate makes the k=2 estimate not merely thin but unusable.
uncertainty_pipeline.what_was_NOT_done: cross-game dispersion, the prior parameter SD and Monte Carlo error were not relabelled as model uncertainty. The asserted constant BASE_EDGE_SD_PP=3.25 in empirical_uncertainty.py was also not used: it carries no computation behind it.
uncertainty_pipeline.consequence: raw EV is computed and shown for every row; no row can reach SELECT or LEAN_HOLD, because a screen that cannot size its own error may not select.
uncertainty_pipeline.remedy: restore Tier-1 provenance on the downgraded dates, which returns 5 date blocks to the admissible pool and makes a k>=6 date-blocked estimate reachable.

model_market_dispersion_review.observation: 10 of 20 priced sides carry positive raw EV, and 9 of those 10 are underdogs at plus money
model_market_dispersion_review.reading: a slate-wide concentration on one side of the market is a signal about the MODEL, not a discovery about the market. Either the model is systematically long underdogs or the market is, and one slate cannot distinguish them.
model_market_dispersion_review.not_a_rule: this triggers a review. It is neither an automatic rejection nor an automatic selection, and it does not change any row's status.
